final: WITH pairs AS (SELECT t.transreg AS transreg, d.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg JOIN trader d ON t.trdref = d.tradereg GROUP BY t.transreg, d.tradekind), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM pairs) SELECT p.tradekind, AVG(p.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(p.cnt * 1.0 / tot.total) AS avg_share FROM pairs p, tot GROUP BY p.tradekind
